bullets.text: CR 94.9 beat the <=96.0 profitability goal following a 99.7 CR through June; all segments earned underwriting profits with margins of 6.2% in PL, 1.2% in CL, and 1.1% in Property.
NPW +20% YOY to $61.6B (+$10.5B); PL NPW +24% and Property +18%; CL grew 8%, with 2023 rate actions expected to earn in at a faster clip during 2024.

Gallup Exceptional Workplace for third consecutive year; 1:1 pay equity maintained for women and people of color; workforce demographics aligned with U.S. adult population; >80% of employees earning <$50k enrolled in medical coverage.

Portfolio returned 6.3% (fixed income 5.4%, equity 26.7%); duration raised to 3.0 years; $0.75/share annual-variable dividend declared; $500M corporate bonds issued; debt-to-total capital ratio closed at 25.4%.

Personal auto rate increases reached 19% in 2023 following 13% in 2022, with some still earning in; additional rate pursued in several states alongside non-rate actions without interstate subsidization.
Media spend was pulled back intentionally to slow new business growth and protect profitability targets; leadership hopes the media team can spend this year's budget efficiently without any cutbacks.

"Uncertainty" was the theme of the annual report; Progressive articulated four cornerstones comprising five Core Values, the Purpose to "help people move forward and live fully," Destination Vision, and four strategic pillars.

Continued inflation, rising loss severity, extreme weather, and macroeconomic trends prompted management to rethink plans; Progressive slowed growth and leveraged rate and non-rate playbooks to achieve its profitability target.

After a rough start, Property earned a 1.1% profit margin; the business continued reducing exposure in volatile weather states and expanding in states that typically have less weather-related volatility.

Market sentiment swung throughout 2023, but a year-end rally lifted returns; fixed income returned 5.4% on higher yield and tighter spreads, and soft-landing consensus helped drive a 26.7% equity return.
